meaning_en: refers to a crime, especially murder, caused by sexual jealousy

example: People	who	carry out	crimes	of	passion	often	regret	their	actions later,	when they	reflect	on	what	they	have	done.

meaning_en: to carry out confinement in prison as a punishment

meaning_en: To start committing crimes or using drugs.
example: During	periods	of	high	youth	unemployment,	some	youngsters turn	to	crime	to obtain	money.

meaning_en: To punish crime sev erely
example: The	crime	rate	is	likely	to	fall	if	governments	take	strong measures	to	be	tough on	crime.

meaning_en: not agree with the decision of the jury after the trial of a case
meaning_bn: আদালতের রায়ের বিরুদ্ধে আপিল বা আপত্তি জানানো
example: In	many	countries,	the	accused person	has	the	right	to	contest t he verdict which	was	reached	in	the	court.

meaning_en: to think about a particular fact or detail and allow it to have some influence when you are making a decision
meaning_bn: কোনো বিষয় বিবেচনায় নেওয়া / আমলে নেওয়া

word: to reintegrate back into society/ community
meaning_en: to restore someone through education or therapy
meaning_bn: সমাজ বা সম্প্রদায়ে অপরাধীদের পুনর্বাসিত করা
example: There	is	an	increasing	focus	among	poli cy - makers	and practitioners	on identifying	programs	and	strategies	that	will	help	prisoners successfully	reintegrate back	into	their	communities	without	re - offending.

meaning_en: not to impose strict punishments on offenders
meaning_bn: অপরাধের প্রতি নমনীয় বা শিথিল মনোভাব দেখানো
example: In	order	to	deter	criminals	effectively,	governments	must	not follow	policies which	are	soft	on	crime.

example: I	would	argue	that	the	most	effective	way	to	reduce	crime	is	to implement	a policy	of	zero	tolerance.

meaning_en: a chance of helping someone to have a normal life after serving a prison sentence
meaning_bn: স্বাভাবিক জীবনে ফিরে আসার বা পুনর্বাসনের সুযোগ
example: We should	give	ex - offerders	a	chance	of	rehabilitation	and teach	them	how	to become	useful	members	of	society.

meaning_en: To start something new
meaning_bn: নতুন কোনো কাজে হাত দেওয়া বা শুরু করা
example: Young	people	sometimes	embark	on	a	life	of	crime	as	a	result	of the	bad influ ence	of	criminals	whom	they	know.

meaning_en: to try something new after making mistakes in one’s life
meaning_bn: নতুন করে জীবন শুরু করা / নতুন উদ্যমে শুরু করা
example: I	believe	that	people	should	have	the	opportunity	to	make	a	fresh start	after they	are	released	from	prison. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 5

meaning_en: to punish by physically harming the offender
example: Many	schools	have abandoned	the	policy	of	corporal punishment	for	children who	misbehave	and	prefer	to	give	extra	work	or detention	after	school	instead.

meaning_en: a sentence which is not served in prison
example: There	is	a	wide	range	of	non	custodial	sentences	which	a	court may	give	to offen ders,	including:	fines,	probation	orders	or	community service	orders.

meaning_en: punishment by death
example: In	some	states	of	America,	those	who	commit	murder	a re sometimes sentenced	to	capital	punishment.

meaning_en: to make a convicted person see an official at regular intervals to check on their good behavior, as an alternative to going to prison
example: The	young	offender	was	put	on	probation,	as	his	crime	was	not serious	enough to	send	him	to	prison.

meaning_en: to stop and hold people who the police think may have committed a crime

meaning_en: the exact wording of the law, without considering any excuses
example: I	believe	that	the	courts	must apply	the	strict	letter	of	the	law and	impose	the harshest	possible	sentences	on	criminals. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 8 MEDIA	AND	ADVERTISIN G

meaning_en: to send out a programme on television or radio that may be false or exagerrated in order to gain support for a political leader, a party , etc

meaning_en: a piece of writing which deals with the most important news item of the day.

example: Newspapers	in	my	country	often	have a	leading	article on	some	sensational crime	that	has	been	committed.

meaning_en: the policy of the newspaper, as decided by the person in charge of producing the news paper
example: The editorial	policy of	a	newspaper	determines	whether	serious	news	items	are reported	in	a	responsible	way.

meaning_en: reporting which tries to get your interest by presenting facts or events as more shocking or worse than they are.
example: Unfortunately, sensational	journalism has	resulted	in	much	public	distrust	of the	media.

meaning_en: to include an item in a news report
meaning_bn: সংবাদ প্রতিবেদনে কোনো ঘটনা অন্তর্ভুক্ত করা

meaning_en: the reporting of news and sport in newspapers, tv, or radio.
example: The	US	presidential	election	received	global news	coverage ,	so	that	the	whole world	became	interested	in	the	outcome.

meaning_en: to be an important item of news in the newspapers, on radio or TV.
example: It	seems	that	every	insignificant	event	in	the	lives	of	celebrities makes	fr ont page	headlines.

meaning_en: newly received information about an event that is currently taking place

meaning_en: having the latest information
example: Newspapers	are	unable	to	provide up	to	the	minute news	coverage	of	events	as they	happen.

meaning_en: information that is no longer interesting or new, because it has already been reported
example: Newspapers	have	now	become	only	a	source	of stale	news ,	which	is	a	major reason	why	they	have	become	less	popular.

meaning_en: the decline in the number of copies of a newspaper sold each day
example: As	a	result	of	their falling	circulation ,	newspapers	are	losing	advertising IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 1 0 revenue.

meaning_en: A form of brand or advertising campaign that involves a well known person using their fame to help promote a product or service Exam ple: Celebrity endorsement by famous TV stars is commonly used by companies to encourage consumers to trust and buy their products.
to pay money regularly in order to receive a copy of a magazine
example: Those	wi th	a	strong	interest	in	a	particular	field	sometimes	prefer to	subscribe to	a	magazine which	has	articles	relating	to	that	area.

meaning_en: Newspapers have increasingly turned to providing expert, detailed analysis of re cent events, for example in their financial or business sections.
advertising a product or service on the internet
example: The	growing	popularity	of online	advertising has	resulted	in	a	loss	of	revenue for	the	printed	me dia	in	general.

word: to slash the prices of products
meaning_en: to reduce the price dramatically
example: Supermarkets,	for	example,	always	carry	huge	in - store	advertisements	when	they slash	the	prices	of	products. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 1 1

meaning_en: not completely trusting or certain about something
meaning_bn: কোনো বিষয়ে সতর্ক বা সাবধান থাকা
example: Consumers	must	always be	wary	of the	claims	made	in	advertisements,	because such	claims	are	often	exagerrated	or	untrue. IELTS	TOPIC	VOCABULARY	BY	NGOCBACH

meaning_en: to make products popular by advertising them
meaning_bn: পণ্যের প্রচার চালানো বা বাজারজাত করা
example: Most	large	enterprises	contract	specialist	marketing	companies to	promote their	products.

meaning_en: to buy things suddenly without any planning and without consid ering the effects they may have
example: Advertising	motivates	consumers to	buy	goods	impulsively .

meaning_en: to be influenced to buy things as a result of advertising
example: If	consumers were not	easily swayed	by	adv ertisements, the	advertising industry	would	not	exist.

meaning_en: the action of collecting information about what people buy
example: In	deciding	how	to	promote	their	products	or	services,	businesses	should	first conduct market researc h.

meaning_en: a situation in which companies or shops continually reduce their prices in order to attract customers away from their competitors
example: Advertising	plays	a	key	role	in price	wars between	supermarkets. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 1 2

meaning_en: to introduce a new product
meaning_bn: বাজারে নতুন পণ্য উন্মোচন বা চালু করা
example: Companies	have	recognised	that	the	services	of	the	marketing	industry	are essential to	launch	a	new	product successfully.

meaning_en: consumers whom businesses aim at when selling their products
meaning_bn: নির্দিষ্ট উদ্দিষ্ট ভোক্তা বা লক্ষ্যদল (টার্গেট অডিয়েন্স)
example: Companies	which	sell	soft	drinks,	like	Coca	Cola,	aim	mainly	at	a target	audience of	children	and	adolescents.

meaning_en: the action of bringing the name of a company to the attention of the public
example: Advertising,	not	the	quality	of	the	product,	is	responsible	for	creating brand awareness among	consumers,	as	can	be	seen	by	the	success	of	market	leaders	such	as	Nike or	Coca	Cola.

meaning_en: the hours during which most people are watching TV
meaning_bn: টেলিভিশনের সবচেয়ে জনপ্রিয় সম্প্রচার সময় (প্রাইম টাইম)
example: Although	advertising	on prime	time	television is	expensive,	it	is	guaranteed	to reach	a	large	audience. VOCABULARY	BY	NGOCBACH

meaning_en: broadcast media which use electronic technology, such as the internet, television, radio, DVDs , etc .
example: In	cont rast, to	print	media, the	electronic	media are	growing	in	popularity, especially	among	the	youth. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 1 3

meaning_en: to control something by means of rules
example: Governments	must impose	regulations	on the	advertising	industry	in	order	to protect	consumers.

meaning_en: advertising on the radio or television, between or during programmes.
example: Commercial	advertising on	televisi on	provides	the	revenue	for	most	TV channels.

meaning_en: a method of selling things or taking orders for sales by telephone
example: Telemarketing has	become	a	growth	industry,	employing	millions	of	people across	the	world. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 1 4 THE	ENVIRO NMENT

meaning_en: a measure of the amount of carbon dioxide that is produced by the daily activities of a company or person
example: By	providing	subsidies,	governments	should	encourage	comp anies	to reduce	their carbon	footprint through	energy	efficiency	or	other	‘green	measures’.

word: To take something into account / consideration

meaning_bn: কোনো বিষয় বিবেচনায় নেওয়া বা আমলে রাখা

meaning_en: to uphold one's promise; to do as one says

meaning_en: to come to an agreement

word: To make the most of something
meaning_en: to make something appear as good as possible; to exploit something; to get as much out of something as is possible.

meaning_en: if a company goes out of business, it stops doing business permanently, especially because it has failed
meaning_bn: ব্যবসা বন্ধ হয়ে যাওয়া বা দেউলিয়া হওয়া

meaning_en: to collect information about what people buy and why they choose it.
meaning_bn: বাজার সমীক্ষা বা ক্রেতাদের পছন্দ অনুসন্ধান করা

meaning_en: to decrease, to reduce

meaning_en: to assess a situation and figure out (or gue ss) the outcome
example: We	cannot make	a	precise	calculation of	the	price	until	we	have	all	the	costs.

meaning_en: refers to making a payment to a supplier later than the terms of the arrangement under which goods or services were purchased from the supplie r.
example: The	company pays	one	month	in	arrears to	all	its	suppliers	and	employees.

meaning_en: to buy something at a usually public sale of goods or property, where people make higher and higher bids (= o ffers of money) for each thing, until the thing is sold to the person who will pay most
example: Buying a	property at	an	auction can	be	a	nerve - wracking	or	exhilerating experience.

meaning_en: to waste money or supplies, or to waste opportunities by not using them to your advantage
meaning_bn: সঞ্চয় বা সুযোগ অপচয় বা নষ্ট করা

example: An	increase	in	rents	in	the	shopping	mall	increased	the overhead	costs of	all	the shops	which	operated	there.

meaning_en: an act of taking over a company by buying its shares Example : Sony made a successful takeover of the broadcasting company CBS.
the action of joining two or more businesses into one
example: The	directors	of Kentucky	Fried	Chicken and Burger	King are	considering	a merger of	the	two	compani es.

meaning_en: having many tasks to perform
example: Many	employees	of	the	company	take	time	off	work	because	of	illness	and	stress due	to	the heavy	workload .

meaning_en: something that somebody gives you [usually money] because they have hurt you or damaged something that you own

meaning_en: the money that a government receives from taxes or which a comp any receives from its business
example: The	tax revenues of	the	government	have	fallen	as	a	result	of	the	economic crisis.

meaning_en: working in an office, not a factory
example: The	insurance	company	is	offering	some white - collar	jobs if	you	want	to	apply.

meaning_en: connected with people who do physical work in industry
meaning_bn: কায়িক শ্রমিক বা কারখানার কর্মী (ব্লু-কলার ওয়ার্কার)
example: He’s	a blue - collar	worker in	a	car	factory.

meaning_en: to have a business which you own
example: I	was	tire d	of	working	for	other	people,	so	I	decided to	run	my	own	business.

meaning_en: to earn money
example: I	used	to earn	a	living as	a	teacher,	but	now	I	sell	used	cars.

meaning_en: to make their company appear more attractive to people
meaning_bn: জনসাধারণের কাছে প্রতিষ্ঠানের ভাবমূর্তি উন্নত করা

meaning_en: to expand a business, usually a new one

example: The	high	quality	of VW cars,	combined	with	their	affordable	price,	has	enabled the	company to	gain	a	competitive edge over	all	its	rivals	in	world	markets.

meaning_en: to increase profits to the highes t possible level
example: The	company	has	hired	a	marketing	consultant	to	recommend	how	to maximize profits next	year.

meaning_en: to operate a business in a particular way
meaning_bn: একটি নির্দিষ্ট নীতিতে ব্যবসা পরিচালনা করা
example: It	is	important	to conduct	a	business with	honesty	in	order	to	gain	the confidence	of	customers IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 2 4

meaning_en: to lose one’s job
meaning_bn: চাকরি থেকে ছাঁটাই হওয়া / উদ্বৃত্ত কর্মী হওয়া
example: The	car	factory	has	closed	and	1000	employees	have been	made	redundant .

meaning_en: a system in which you and your employer pay money regularly into a fund, to use when you retire from work

example: One	of	the	benefits	of	working	for	a	big	corporation	is	that	such	large	companies usually	provide	a	good pension	scheme. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 2 5 GOVERNMENT

meaning_en: to accept and act according to a law, an agreement, etc.

example: Motorists	who	do	not abide	by the	rules	of	the	road	should	be	severely punished.

meaning_en: a system of government in which candidates are voted to rep resent the people of a country in a national parliament or assembly
example: Freedom	of	speech	is	usually	one	of	the	rights	enjoyed	by	citizens	in	a parliamentary	democracy.

meaning_en: to behave according to a particular law, rule, set of instructions,
meaning_bn: নিয়ম বা আইন দৃঢ়ভাবে অনুসরণ করা (টু অ্যাডহিয়ার টু)
example: Governments	which	fail to	adhere	to their	election	promises	generally	become unpopular	very	quickly.

meaning_en: connected with the laws which a country is governed by
example: The	media	have	an	imp ortant	role	to	play	in	reporting	on	the	actions	of politicians,	to	ensure	the	proper	functioning	of constitutional	government.

meaning_en: that part of the government organisation responsible for implementing laws and decisions Ex ample: The enforcement of policies affecting schools and hospitals is the responsibility of the executive branch of the government.
that part of the government responsible for making laws
meaning_bn: সরকারের আইনসভা বা আইন প্রণয়নকারী শাখা

meaning_bn: ক্ষমতার পৃথকীকরণ নীতি (আইন, নির্বাহী ও বিচার বিভাগ)
example: In	the	USA,	the	independence	of	the	courts	from	the	government	is	safeguarded by the	separation	of	powers

meaning_en: to start to use particular policies Example : In order to deal with traffic congestion, the government must adopt policies to restrict the use of private cars.
to introduce new rules to spend less money on something
meaning_bn: ব্যয়সংকোচন বা বাজেট ছাঁটাই আরোপ করা
example: It	is	essential	for	the	authorities to	impose	spending	cuts on	space	programs	in order	to	fund	health	services.

meaning_en: to increase the amount of tax on something
example: Governments	should raise	taxes	on cigarettes	to persuade	more	people	to	give up	smoking.

meaning_en: to restrict what the government spends on something
meaning_bn: সরকারি ব্যয়ে রাশ টানা বা সীমাবদ্ধ করা
example: I	would	argue	that	it	is	preferable to	curb	public	spending	on building	new roads	rather	than	to	impose	spen ding	cuts	on	education.

meaning_en: to make money and materials available to do something
meaning_bn: নির্দিষ্ট খাতে সম্পদ বা অর্থ বরাদ্দ দেওয়া
example: If	governments allocate	more	resources	to improving	public	transport,	this	will reduce	the	problem	of	traffic	congestion	in cities.

meaning_en: to limit what people can do or what can happen
example: The	government	must introduce	restrictions	on smoking	in	public	places. 14 . to	infringe	on/upon	something Meaning:	to	limit	somebody’s	legal	r ights Example:	Governments	must	sometimes infringe	upon	individual	freedoms in	the	wider interests	of	society. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 2 7

meaning_en: something which is so important that the government should deal with it first.
example: In	developing	countries,	spending	on	health	and	education	should be	top government	priorities.

meaning_en: to put the need to spend money on certain things first
meaning_bn: নির্দিষ্ট খাতে সরকারি ব্যয়ে অগ্রাধিকার দেওয়া
example: I	believe	that	it	is	important to	priorit ize	expenditure	on medical	research	in order	to	save	lives.

meaning_en: to give money to enable something to be done
meaning_bn: নির্দিষ্ট উদ্যোগের জন্য তহবিল বা অর্থ বরাদ্দ প্রদান

meaning_en: something which is among the first things in the list of actions to be taken

meaning_en: to use power to influence somebody or something

meaning_en: to give government money to reduce the costs of services or t o produce goods in order to keep the price low

meaning_en: organizations which oper ate in many countries

meaning_en: government organizations acting at a national level or within a smaller, local area

meaning_en: a charity or association that is independent of government or business

meaning_en: to take part in a series of activities in order to achieve a specific aim.
meaning_bn: নির্দিষ্ট লক্ষ্যের পক্ষে প্রচারণা বা আন্দোলন চালানো
example: People	who	are	concerned	about	the	environment	should campaign	for stricter controls	on	pollution.

meaning_en: the process of deciding about something official
example: Pressure	groups	are	sometimes	able	to	influen ce government	decision - making.

word: to impose an official ban on

meaning_en: the act of providing financial support by the government
example: Government	sponsorship of	the	arts	is	necessary	if	creative	talent	is	to	be encouraged. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 2 9

meaning_en: a taxation system which allows governments to provid e for the economic and social well - being of its citizens
example: In	order	to	eradicate	poverty,	I	believe	that a	welfare	state should	be	established in	all	developing	countries.

meaning_en: a policy or action adopted for a short ti me until some more permanent solution is found

meaning_en: to start doing a sport, to start doing exercise
meaning_bn: খেলাধুলা বা শরীরচর্চা শুরু করা (টু টেক আপ স্পোর্ট)

meaning_en: to become fit
meaning_bn: সুঠাম দেহের অধিকারী হওয়া বা ফিট হওয়া

meaning_en: to stay in good physical condition

meaning_en: to make a big physical effort to do something
meaning_bn: কঠোর শারীরিক পরিশ্রম বা উদ্যম প্রয়োগ করা

word: to work out at the gym
meaning_en: to train the body by physical exercise at the gym
example: As	part	of	a	healthy	lifestyle,	people	of	all	ages	should work	out	at	the	gym on	a regular	basis.

meaning_en: to be physically unfit

word: to be in the peak of condition
meaning_en: to be in the best possible physical condition
meaning_bn: শারীরিক স্বাস্থ্যের চরম শীর্ষে বা সেরা অবস্থায় থাকা

meaning_en: to do exercise which is not physically demanding or tiring
meaning_bn: হালকা বা মৃদু শারীরিক ব্যায়াম করা

meaning_en: taking exercise in less common ways, involving the mind as well as the body
meaning_bn: ব্যায়ামের বিকল্প ও আধুনিক রূপ (যেমন ইয়োগা)

meaning_en: to ban or prohibit sports which have a high risk of causing injury

meaning_en: you are very likely/not very likely to be injured

meaning_en: injuries which are so serious that the person may die

meaning_en: a sporting activity which is very dangerous

meaning_en: the equipment and clothing needed to practice a particular sport
example: In	order	to reduce	the	risks	associated	with	dangerous	sports,	participants should	undergo	rigorous	training	and	use	all	the essential	sports	gear required.

meaning_en: to do something in advance in order to prevent problems or to av oid danger
example: Anyone	engaging	in	an	extreme	sport	must take	sensible	precautions and	seek expert	advice.

meaning_en: encourage the desire to beat others in a sports event
meaning_bn: প্রতিযোগিতামূলক মনোভাব ও জয়ের আকাঙ্ক্ষা উৎসাহিত করা
example: The	problem	with	encouraging	spo rt	at	school	is	that	it fosters	a competitive spirit among	students,	instead	of	teaching	children	simply	to	do	the	best	that	they	can	in	all aspects	of	life.

meaning_en: the ultimate goal is not to win but to know that you have taken part and done your best in a competition
meaning_bn: অলিম্পিক আদর্শ (জয়ের চেয়ে অংশগ্রহণ ও সর্বোচ্চ প্রচেষ্টাই মুখ্য)

meaning_en: an idea that a match or competition must be won, using all possible means

meaning_en: not to be allowed to join a competition
meaning_bn: প্রতিযোগিতায় অংশগ্রহণে অযোগ্য বা বহিষ্কৃত হওয়া

meaning_en: drugs which improve the ability of a sportsperson to compete
meaning_bn: শক্তি বা পারফরম্যান্স বর্ধক নিষিদ্ধ ওষুধ (ডোপিং ড্রাগ)

meaning_en: to fail an examination before or after a competition to make sure that you have not take n illegal drugs to improve your performance
meaning_bn: ডোপ টেস্ট বা মাদক পরীক্ষায় ব্যর্থ হওয়া
example: Cycling	is	a	sport	which	has	been	discredited	in	recent	years,	as	so	many competitors	have failed	drugs	tests.

meaning_en: to use drugs or medicines which are not allowed under the rules of a competition
meaning_bn: খেলাধুলায় নিষিদ্ধ রাসায়নিক পদার্থ ব্যবহার করা

example: I	would	argue	that	schools place	too	much	value	on	sport in	the	curriculum,	and participation	in	sport	should	be	an	out - of - school	activity.

meaning_en: a person who takes a keen interest in sport

meaning_en: to achieve the best result ever achieved in a sport
meaning_bn: নতুন রেকর্ড সৃষ্টি করা বা নতুন ইতিহাস গড়া

meaning_en: the activity of reporting news related to sport
example: Many	top	sports	stars	are	now	known	to	millions	of	people	around	the	world because	of	global sports	coverage by	the	media.

meaning_en: people who are experts on sport and talk or write about it in the media
example: Not	only	sports	stars,	but	even	some sports	commentators have	become	well - known	celebrities. IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 3 4

meaning_en: the activity of selling products connected with a sport or sportsperson
meaning_bn: খেলোয়াড় বা খেলাধুলা সংক্রান্ত পণ্য বিপণন ও বিক্রয়
example: Sports	merchandising is	a	multi - billion	dollar	business	worldwide,	in	the	form of	t - shirts	and	sports	equipment.

meaning_en: an advertising statement, usually by a famous sportsperson, saying that they use or like a particular product.
meaning_bn: ক্রীড়া পণ্যের বিজ্ঞাপনী সমর্থন বা অনুমোদন
example: In	addition	to	their	fabulous	salaries,	sports	celebrities	also	make	a	great	deal	of money	through	their endorsement	of	sporting	goo ds such	as	trainers	or	ev en	casual clothes	or	deodorants ! IELTS	VOCABULARY	BY TOPICS 3 5 SPACE	EXPLORATION

meaning_en: a voyage into space which has a person to control it

meaning_en: the universe, especially when it is t hought of as an ordered system

meaning_bn: মহাকাশ গবেষণায় বিপুল অর্থ ব্যয় বা বিনিয়োগ করা

meaning_en: journeys into space

meaning_en: the act of gaining control over the difficult task of exploring space

meaning_en: to move slowly in the air

meaning_en: the technology of sending electronic devices into space for communications purposes
example: Satellite	technology has	resulted	in	huge	advances	in	communications	and information - gathering.

meaning_en: a useful result of an activity that was designed to produce something different (e.g. satellite technology from space research)
meaning_bn: গবেষণার ফলস্বরূপ প্রাপ্ত যুগান্তকারী উপজাত প্রযুক্তি (স্পিন-অফ)

example: Holidays	in	space	are	just	fantasy.	It	is	doubtful	if	it	will	ever	be	possible to	make space	travel	commercially	viable.

meaning_en: creatures from another world

meaning_en: life that may exist on another planet

word: In the realm of science fiction

example: Most	of	the	arguments	in	favour	of	space	programs	are in	the	realm	of	science fiction.
